questions.say: All my public work is on GitHub. The list below is pulled live, so it is always current. Highlights: this site (you.can-du-ai.com), CatMsg (a Flutter + Firebase chat app), and D.U.AI (an automated daily AI news digest).

questions.q: Show me websites you have created.
questions.say: I build and deploy my own sites under the can-du-ai.com domain, managed through Cloudflare DNS. Each one is live; open any link.

items.title: You Can Du AI
items.desc: This AI training site: knowledge library, question bank, configurable tests, AI tutor, AI course generator with PDF slides, YouTube summaries. Static site on GitHub Pages, auto-deployed by GitHub Actions.

items.title: Can-Du-AI
items.desc: Main Can-Du-AI website.

items.title: CatMsg (PurrCord)
items.desc: Cat-themed, Discord-style messaging app.

items.title: Quran reader
items.desc: Arabic Quran reading site.

items.title: Medical Suppliers Inventory
items.desc: Inventory web app for medical supplies.

questions.q: Show me the tools you use.
questions.say: I work AI-first: coding agents for building, frontier and local models for the AI features, and cloud platforms for deployment.

items.title: AI coding agents
items.desc: Claude Code (Anthropic), OpenAI Codex, Cursor, VS Code.

items.title: Models and AI platforms
items.desc: Claude, Google Gemini API and Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek and other APIs.

items.title: Local AI
items.desc: Ollama and LM Studio for running open models on my own machine.

items.title: Languages and frameworks
items.desc: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Dart/Flutter, Astro, Node.js, uv.

items.title: Cloud and deployment
items.desc: GitHub, GitHub Actions and Pages, Cloudflare (Pages, Workers, Wrangler, DNS), Firebase, Google Cloud SDK, Docker.

items.title: Media
items.desc: FFmpeg for audio and video processing.

questions.q: Show me the AI skills and extensions you have installed.
questions.say: I extend my coding agent with skills, plugins and MCP servers so it can do more than write code: research the web, drive a browser, build knowledge graphs and render video.

items.title: graphify (skill)
items.desc: Turns code, documents, papers or images into a queryable knowledge graph.

items.title: HyperFrames (skill)
items.desc: Makes and renders videos from HTML: explainers, title cards, captions.

items.title: Context7 (skill)
items.desc: Pulls up-to-date library documentation into the agent's context.

items.title: ponytail (skill)
items.desc: Lean-engineering mode: smallest complete change, plus code review and audit commands.

items.title: OpenAI Codex plugin
items.desc: Lets Claude Code hand tasks to Codex for a second opinion.

items.title: Android reverse-engineering plugin
items.desc: Decompiles APKs and traces API calls.

items.title: Design plugin
items.desc: Design critique, accessibility review, UX copy and handoff specs.

items.title: MCP servers
items.desc: Perplexity (research), Firecrawl (web scraping), Playwright and Claude in Chrome (browser automation).

questions.say: I automate the repetitive parts: content collection, publishing and deployment, so the work runs without me.

items.title: D.U.AI: Daily Update of AI
items.desc: Collects AI news from TechCrunch, MIT Technology Review and MIT News RSS feeds and picks up to eight unique stories from the past 48 hours for a one-page digest, with an owner-only admin.

items.title: Test-and-deploy pipeline
items.desc: Every push runs the self-tests and, if they pass, deploys this site to GitHub Pages automatically.

items.title: YouTube to summary
items.desc: Paste a YouTube link; Gemini watches the video and writes a summary or transcript in English or Arabic, saved to the knowledge library.

items.title: AI course generator
items.desc: Name any subject and get lessons, a PDF slide deck and a graded test in one step.

questions.q: Show me a chatbot you built.
questions.say: The AI tutor on this site is mine: a bilingual chatbot that answers AI questions and files each saved answer under the right topic by itself.

items.title: Ask AI tutor
items.desc: Multi-turn chatbot with a tutor system prompt, English and Arabic replies, and one-click saving; a second model call classifies each answer into the matching knowledge topic.

questions.q: Tell me about a project you are proud of.
questions.say: You Can Du AI. I designed it as a learning platform for AI engineers: 100+ curated sources including Arabic ones, 90+ verified questions, configurable tests, personal study plans from test results, an AI tutor, AI-generated courses with PDF slides, and automated test-and-deploy. It has no backend: everything runs in the browser, and each visitor uses their own AI key.

items.title: Live site
items.desc: Open it and try a test or the AI tutor.

items.title: Source code
items.desc: Plain HTML/JS, self-tests in test.mjs.

questions.q: How do you use AI in your day-to-day work?
questions.say: I treat AI as a team: a coding agent builds and tests, research tools gather sources, and I review, decide and ship. I keep secrets out of code, test before deploying, and verify AI output against primary sources.
